title: 巴基斯坦财长：1000亿美元外债如何优化？不急于求成，重在拉长期限
speaker: Muhammad Aurangzeb

segments.en: We have given mandates for also for the first time dollar settled but repeat denominated bonds. A lot of reverse inquiries coming through on that as well.
segments.zh: 我们还首次授权了美元结算但以本币计价的债券。这方面也收到了很多反向询价。

segments.en: And then going forward we are going to issue RFPs for the remaining panda bond because NAFME approval is for billion dollars. We printed 250 and for the first time we are also going to see if we can go for tokenization of our existing euro bonds.
segments.zh: 接下来我们将为剩余的熊猫债券发出招标书，因为NAFME批准了10亿美元额度。我们已经发行了2.5亿，并且首次尝试将现有欧元债券进行代币化。

segments.en: So now in a rush does this mean this comes potentially next year or what sort of timeline are you looking at? And how much for each of these? From our perspective it's going to be determined by pricing, tenor and market conditions.
segments.zh: 那么不急于求成是否意味着可能明年进行？您看的时间表是怎样的？每项规模多大？从我们的角度看，这将取决于定价、期限和市场条件。

segments.en: So the way I was sort of explaining to you a bit earlier as well that this year it's not a question of that we absolutely need to cover our external financing gap.
segments.zh: 正如我之前向您解释的，今年并不是我们绝对需要填补外部融资缺口的问题。

segments.en: But over the next two to three years what we do want to do is to see if some of our short term external debt can be refinanced into longer tenors, longer maturities. So Pakistan as a country does not have to go into this role over risk on sort of short term debt.
segments.zh: 但在未来两到三年，我们想做的是看看能否将部分短期外债再融资为更长期限、更长到期日。这样巴基斯坦作为一个国家就不必承担短期债务的滚动风险。

segments.en: Quite frankly it is not helpful to us from the rating agencies perspective as well. They do not give us any credit for that. So we want to keep the overall quantum of our external debt which is close to about 100 billion dollars.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，从评级机构的角度看，这对我们也没有帮助。他们不会因此给我们加分。所以我们希望保持外债总规模，目前接近1000亿美元。

segments.en: But think about it as mostly as replacement trades as diversification and as elongating the maturity.
segments.zh: 但可以把它看作主要是置换交易、多元化和拉长到期期限。
